final: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS x ON x.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg FROM pair_averages), kept_pairs AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.avg_anlycount, p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_pair_avg AS amount_above FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_pair_avg), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(amount_above) AS avg_amount_above FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_anlycount, avg_amount_above, avg_anlycount / (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) FROM type_averages) AS ratio_to_mean_type_avg FROM type_averages
